name: Générations Star Wars et Science Fiction
blurb: France's largest Star Wars fan gathering, a free two-day convention in Cusset with actor guests, exhibits and charity fundraising, running since 1999.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'PROCHAINE ÉDITION 15 ET 16 MAI 2027 À CUSSET (03)' and news post dated 15 September 2026 'RDV pour la 28e édition de Générations Star Wars et SF !' announcing those dates.

notes: The seed note's '2-3 May 2026' date was the 27th edition, which already happened (a 7 May 2026 post thanks attendees for that weekend); the site has since announced the 28th edition for 15-16 May 2027 at Espace Chambon, 1 rue du Faubourg du Chambon, Cusset (confirmed via WebFetch of the venue/practical-info page, since the homepage nav links weren't exposed as plain <a> tags to extract.mjs). Entry is free ('Entièrement gratuit'), so no ticket link. No confirmed actor/guest lineup for the 2027 edition yet (the association's own site didn't show one, and genstarwars.fr has no public guest list page distinct from its practical-info/venue content as of this check) — guests is 'none-yet' rather than carrying over 2026's lineup. Organizer is the hosting non-profit association named on the site ('association loi 1901 organisant la convention'). Cover uses the official wordmark (og), the only clear key art; other homepage images are candid photos from past editions.
